cases.task: Fix compaction-summary conversion in cortexterm/anthropic_adapter.py. After compaction, a retained suffix may start with assistant tool_use. The current converter places the older conversation summary in the system prompt, leaving no user context before that suffix. Represent marked summaries as user conversation context, including legacy checkpoints whose internal role is system. Keep the real system prompt separate, preserve tool-use/result pairs, and enclose summary text in <summary> newline ... newline </summary>. Use the existing conversion conventions and keep existing tests passing.
cases.history: Provider-boundary lesson: isCompactionSummary describes the semantic meaning of a checkpoint; check it before ordinary role dispatch. Internal storage roles need not equal API roles. The system prompt must contain instructions, not a summary of user/assistant history. A summary replaces old conversational turns, so convert it to a user text block. Reuse _push_anthropic_message to merge adjacent same-role blocks without losing tool IDs.

cases.task: Fix batched-tool handling in cortexterm/agent_loop.py. The model can return A, a tool whose result has awaitUser=True, and C in the same batch. Currently C is skipped. Finish every sibling tool call in order, record every result with its original ID, then return the question for the user without another model request. The awaitUser signal may come from any tool, not just a tool named ask_user. Preserve existing callbacks and normal tool-loop behavior.
cases.history: Tool orchestration lesson: a batch is one model response. Store its calls before executing their results; user input should begin only after the batch has a result for each call. awaitUser is a property of ToolResult, not a special tool name. Accumulate a pending question across the batch, then leave the outer model loop after all siblings finish. Do not let a later ordinary result erase an earlier awaitUser decision.
